purpose: Compare documented failures of protection, information handling and accountability with private-intelligence/security capabilities without presuming a single coordinated system.
core_distinctions: failure is not automatically intentional interference
reputation protection is not automatically criminal obstruction

anchor_cases.name: Lawrence Nassar / FBI handling
anchor_cases.critical_counterevidence: DOJ OIG explicitly said it did not find evidence that Indianapolis officials' failures were motivated by intent to interfere with the investigation.
anchor_cases.lesson: Catastrophic protection failure can be real without evidence of a centralized conspiracy.

anchor_cases.name: Jimmy Savile / UK policing intelligence failures
anchor_cases.lesson: Fragmented information and poor investigation can create long-lived protection effects without requiring one protecting command structure.

anchor_cases.name: Harvey Weinstein / Black Cube
anchor_cases.lesson: Wealth and legal intermediaries can purchase private-intelligence capabilities inside reputation and media conflicts.

anchor_cases.name: Epstein/Maxwell DOJ transparency corpus
anchor_cases.lesson: A giant corpus requires stricter provenance because the DOJ itself warns it includes responsive public submissions that may be false or fake.

anchor_cases.name: NXIVM / Keith Raniere
anchor_cases.lesson: Use adjudicated conduct to anchor high-control analysis rather than transferring a cult label by analogy.

private_intelligence_and_surveillance.official_claim: Commerce said evidence showed spyware supplied to foreign governments was used to maliciously target officials, journalists, activists and others.

private_intelligence_and_surveillance.caution: Large public-sector deployment documents capability and customer base, not misuse in any specific case.

private_intelligence_and_surveillance.reported_2024: Strategic partnership with Israeli Defense Ministry to supply technology assisting Israel in the ongoing war.
private_intelligence_and_surveillance.caution: Contract/partnership evidence must remain separate from allegations about specific targeting, intelligence use or unlawful conduct.

victim_safety_rules: Prefer aggregate or anonymized affected-party records unless public identification is necessary to understand a public court/inquiry record.
Do not republish redacted personal information from source corpora.
Do not create entertainment rankings, scores or gamified victim counts.
Separate survivor testimony from third-party allegations and from adjudicated findings.
Represent institutional repair, restitution and prevention alongside harm.
research_questions: Which industries routinely buy private-intelligence, crisis-PR or investigations services and under what legal controls?
Which abuse scandals show the same failure mechanisms despite having unrelated actors?
Which public agencies contract with major digital-forensics or data-integration vendors, and what oversight governs deployment?
Which mechanisms create protection effects without requiring intentional coordination?
Where did reforms measurably reduce recurrence after inquiry or scandal?
